narrative: Operators inheriting this repo hit a wall of April-2026 spike artefacts — dead modules, a FastAPI metrics stack, failing tests, no licence, and a bootstrap that required Docker. This change deletes everything that was never shipped, archives the pre-prune HEAD, adds AGPL-3.0 licence and Apache CLA, and leaves the suite green. A contributor can now clone, run bootstrap.sh without Docker, run pytest, and get zero failures.
